        lastName:
          title: Last name

        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner (e.g. MR, MRS,
            MS, DR). When present it is combined with the last name to form the
            owner's 'salutation'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 10
          example: DR
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted for backward
            compatibility; when structured 'addressLine1' is supplied it takes
            precedence and this value is composed from the normalized address lines
            and returned here.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the structured postal address. Preferred over
            the flat 'address' when present; normalized (upper-cased, whitespace
            collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded) like the flat address.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the structured postal address.
            Normalized like 'addressLine1' and, when present, appended to it (separated
            by a single space) to form the composed 'address'.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Apt 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          pattern: '(?s).*\S.*'
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. On create it is normalized
            to E.164 form; a leading '+' and country code are kept, otherwise country
            code '+61' is assumed and a single leading '0' is dropped from the national
            digits. Spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped and the result must carry
            8 to 15 digits after the '+' (e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678').
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9 ()+.-]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when present it
            must be a syntactically valid address and is normalized to lower-case.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com

          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'

## Summary

I changed owner deletion to a soft-delete. Here's what I did:

**Model** (`Owner.java`)
- Added a `deleted` boolean field (`@Column(name = "deleted")`) with a `getDeleted()`/`setDeleted()` pair. `getDeleted()` returns non-null (`false` when unset), so a newly created owner is `deleted: false` without any extra initialization.

**API schema** (`openapi.yml`)
- Added a read-only `deleted` boolean property to the `Owner` schema, so the generated `OwnerDto` carries the field and MapStruct maps it automatically. This is what surfaces `$.deleted` on `GET /api/owners/{id}`.

**Database schema** (`db/{hsqldb,h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql`)
- Added a `deleted BOOLEAN` column to the `owners` table. The tests run under the `hsqldb` profile with `ddl-auto=none`, so the column had to be declared in `schema.sql` explicitly.

**Controller** (`OwnerRestControllerV1.java`)
- `deleteOwner` now sets `deleted = true` and calls `saveOwner` (retaining the row) instead of `deleteOwner`, still returning `204 No Content` (2xx).
- The create endpoint's **household-duplicate**, **identity-key**, and **possible-duplicate** checks now filter out owners flagged `deleted`, so a normally-blocking duplicate is allowed when the only matching owner has been soft-deleted.

The new `Cp46Tests` (both cases) and all 57 existing tests pass.
